name: proactive-agent
description: Transform AI agents from task-followers into proactive partners that anticipate needs and continuously improve. Now with WAL Protocol, Working Buffer, Autonomous Crons, and battle-tested patterns. Par
descriptionZh: 将 AI 代理从任务执行者转变为能够预见需求、持续优化的主动伙伴。现已支持 WAL Protocol、Working Buffer、Autonomous Crons 及经过实战验证的模式。属于 Hal Stack 🦞。

en.tagline: Patterns for proactive work and context-loss recovery
en.summary: Proactive Agent is a set of patterns and file templates for AI agents. It covers writing key details to disk, recovering after context is truncated, designing cron jobs, and limits on how the agent changes its own rules. It aims to make an agent act on likely needs and keep its state across sessions.
problem: Agents lose details when context is compacted or truncated. A correction or decision made earlier in a session can disappear, and the agent may ask the human to repeat it.

Agents also tend to wait for instructions. Cron jobs written as plain prompts may sit unused, and a report of "done" may only reflect a changed prompt, not a changed mechanism. With this skill, key details are written to files before the reply, the agent recovers from a working buffer, and it checks the mechanism behind a change.
fit: Long sessions with many corrections, names, and decisions
Setups that use cron jobs for background checks and maintenance
Retiring or replacing a tool and finding every reference to update
unfit: Single short questions with no follow-up or saved state
Setups where the agent cannot write to a workspace, since memory is kept in local Markdown files
steps: Copy the templates into your workspace with `cp assets/*.md ./`.
On first run, the agent detects ONBOARDING.md and asks questions to fill in USER.md and SOUL.md.
The agent scans each message for corrections, names, preferences, decisions, draft changes, and specific values, and writes them to SESSION-STATE.md before it replies.
After context passes 60%, each exchange is appended to memory/working-buffer.md.
After compaction, the agent reads the working buffer, SESSION-STATE.md, and recent daily notes before it continues.

zh.tagline: 主动工作与上下文丢失后的恢复模式
zh.summary: Proactive Agent 是一套面向 AI 智能体的模式和文件模板。它涵盖把关键细节写入磁盘、上下文被截断后的恢复、定时任务的设计，以及对智能体自我修改规则的限制。它的目标是让智能体在用户开口前处理可能需要的事，并在多次会话之间保持状态。
problem: 上下文被压缩或截断后，智能体会丢失细节。前面会话中的更正或决定可能消失，智能体只能让用户重新说明。
智能体也倾向于被动等待指令。写成普通提示词的定时任务可能无人执行；报告“已完成”时，实际上可能只改了提示词，底层机制并未改变。使用本技能后，关键细节会在回复前写入文件，智能体从工作缓冲区恢复上下文，并会核对变更背后的机制是否真的生效。
fit: 长会话中有大量更正、名称和决定
用定时任务做后台检查和维护的环境
停用或替换某个工具，需要找出并更新所有引用的场景
unfit: 只有单次简短问答、没有后续、也不需要保存状态的场景
智能体无法写入工作区的环境，因为记忆保存在本地 Markdown 文件中
steps: 用 `cp assets/*.md ./` 把模板复制到工作区。
首次运行时，智能体检测到 ONBOARDING.md，并通过提问填写 USER.md 和 SOUL.md。
智能体扫描每条消息中的更正、名称、偏好、决定、草稿修改和具体数值，在回复前先写入 SESSION-STATE.md。
上下文使用超过 60% 后，每一轮对话都会追加到 memory/working-buffer.md。
压缩发生后，智能体先读取工作缓冲区、SESSION-STATE.md 和最近的每日笔记，再继续工作。
运行 `./scripts/security-audit.sh` 检查当前配置。
